# Aviv Msika — Generative Engine Optimization Map

> Aviv Msika is a Social Media Manager and Creative Strategist who blends data-driven strategy with high-end visual storytelling. Operating as an end-to-end creative professional, Aviv handles everything from in-house content strategy to full production — including professional photography, video editing, and Reels/TikTok-style content. The brand exudes sophistication and artistry, targeting premium lifestyle, culinary, and e-commerce clients who demand polished, visually stunning digital presence. The aesthetic is minimalist and refined — beige, black, and white — evoking a luxury editorial feel.

### Contact form

- Content-Type: application/json
- Fields:
  - `name` (text, required)
  - `email` (email, required)
  - `phone` (tel)
  - `message` (textarea, required)
  - `privacy_consent` (checkbox, required)

## About Aviv Msika
Aviv Msika is a Social Media Manager and Creative Strategist who blends data-driven strategy with high-end visual storytelling. Operating as an end-to-end creative professional, Aviv handles everything from in-house content strategy to full production — including professional photography, video editing, and Reels/TikTok-style content.
